items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: we were doing Lennie Tristano and Miles and all those tunes

ctx.x: There’s something about having an instrument or something between you and the audience or the people that are watching.

Yeah well you know the first group I was with was called Teddy Voltz and the Overtones. It was a real bebop group. It was accordion, bass and guitar. And I remember you know we’d start playing tunes, we were doing Lennie Tristano and Miles and all those tunes. And if the audience, like if they started dancing or something we’d change the tempo. It was like an insult that they were enjoying it. You know we were like real artists. And so it got to the point where we had fewer and fewer gigs. And so they’d push me…
